intervals.label: PETRA data taking
intervals.locator: DESY backgrounder "The discovery of the gluon"; end from Bethke & Wagner (2022), Table 1
intervals.note: Start = January 1979 data-taking (the detector moved into the beam in October 1978); end = the 3 November 1986 final shutdown of PETRA and its experiments.
intervals.quote: Data-taking started in January 1979 by the detectors MARK J, PLUTO and TASSO.

intervals.label: PETRA shut down; experiment ended
intervals.note: All PETRA experiments ended with the final shutdown of PETRA as a collider.
intervals.quote: final shutdown of PETRA and experiments

summary.plain: The international team behind the MARK J detector at DESY's PETRA collider, with groups from Germany, the United States, the Netherlands and China, led by Samuel Ting.
summary.technical: MARK J collaboration (leader S. Ting): III. Physikalisches Institut TH Aachen, DESY Hamburg, MIT Laboratory for Nuclear Science, NIKHEF-H Amsterdam and IHEP (Chinese Academy of Science, Peking), as named on the 1979 PRL author list.
